=={{header|FreeBASIC}}==
=== Fast doubling Fibonacci ===
{{libheader|big_int}}
<syntaxhighlight lang="vbnet">#include "big_int/big_integer.bi"

Dim Shared As BigInt zero, one, two
zero = 0 : one = 1 : two = 2

Function BigIntToStr(Byref n As BigInt) As String
    If n = 0 Then Return "0"
    Dim As String result
    Dim As BigInt tmp = n
    Dim As BigInt digit
    
    While tmp <> 0
        digit = tmp Mod 10
        result = Chr(Cint(digit) + Asc("0")) & result
        tmp \= 10
    Wend
    
    Return result
End Function

Sub FibFast(n As Ulongint, Byref fn As BigInt)
    Dim As BigInt a, b, c, d, t1, t2
    a = 0
    b = 1
    
    Dim As Ulongint bit_ = 1ULL Shl 63
    While bit_ > 0 Andalso (n And bit_) = 0
        bit_ Shr=1
    Wend
    
    While bit_ > 0
        ' c = F(2k) = F(k)*(2*F(k+1) - F(k))
        t1 = b * 2
        t1 -= a
        c = a * t1
        
        ' d = F(2k+1) = F(k)^2 + F(k+1)^2
        t1 = a * a
        t2 = b * b
        d = t1 + t2
        
        If (n And bit_) <> 0 Then
            ' (a,b) = (d, c+d)
            t1 = c + d
            a = d
            b = t1
        Else
            ' (a,b) = (c, d)
            a = c
            b = d
        End If
        
        bit_ Shr=1
    Wend
    
    fn = a
End Sub

Sub ShowFib(label As String, n As Ulongint)
    Dim As BigInt f
    FibFast(n, f)
    Dim As String fs = BigIntToStr(f)
    If Len(fs) <= 20 Then 
        Print "Fibonacci(" & label & ") = " & fs
    Else
        Print "Fibonacci(" & label & ") = " & Left(fs, 20) & " ... " & Right(fs, 20)
    End If
End Sub

' Main program
Print !"Computing Fibonacci numbers using fast doubling:\n"
ShowFib("10", 10)
ShowFib("10^2", 100)
ShowFib("10^3", 1000)
ShowFib("10^4", 10000)
ShowFib("10^5", 100000)
ShowFib("10^6", 1000000)
ShowFib("10^7", 10000000)
ShowFib("2^16", 2^16)
ShowFib("2^32", 2^32)

Sleep</syntaxhighlight>
